business_summary: AL Robot Co., Ltd. manufactures force and torque sensors for robotics and industrial applications in South Korea and Japan. The company offers 6-axis force/torque sensors that measure simultaneous force and torque, joint torque sensors under the TSR-J Series for robotic joint applications across small, medium, and heavy-duty load ranges, and rotary torque sensors for measuring torque in rotating components. It also manufactures accessories, including data logging devices for real-time sensor data recording and analysis, as well as wireless communication modules for sensor communication and power supply. Additionally, the company designs custom force and torque sensors and develops custom electronics, such as signal conditioning, data acquisition systems, and integrated control systems. It also provides technical support services for its sensor products and calibration laboratory services for torque measurement. The company serves robotics, manufacturing, medical, research and education, aerospace and defense, and sports and life science applications. AL Robot Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bucheon-si, South Korea.
